title: Text protection
description: Replace domains and brand names before sending, then restore them in responses.
loadError: Could not load settings. Please retry.
caseHint: When off, English letter case is ignored. Restored text uses the source spelling.
scopeHint: Unselected providers are not protected, including providers selected during retries.
rulesHint: Up to 100 rules. Longer matches take priority. Aliases may share prefixes but must not overlap source terms.
coverage: Images and attachments pass through unchanged; their contents are not protected. Detectable text residue or alias collisions block sending.
invalid: Invalid rules. Fill in sources and aliases; avoid duplicates, source/alias overlap, quotes and backslashes. Enabling requires a rule; selected scope requires a provider.
saveError: Save failed. Your edits are still on this page. Please retry.
conflict: Another administrator changed the settings. Reloading discards your unsaved edits.
applyHint: Applies immediately here and within 5 seconds on other instances.

sources.database: Using settings saved in the dashboard. These override the environment variable.
sources.environment: Using the environment variable. Saving switches to dashboard management.
sources.default: Not configured. Text protection is off.
